item.name: Blue Flaming Knife
item.obtainDetail: Purchase in the Shop for 800 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Sets your blade alight with blue fire, the cool-toned sibling of the classic Flaming Knife. A straightforward Diamond buy from the shop.

item.name: Doge
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the shop for 500 coins (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Small Doge heads drift off the knife, and victims turn into a Doge on death. A meme relic that left the shop with the Season 1 update, so only older accounts carry it.

item.name: Dual Wield
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the shop for 900 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Puts a mirrored second knife in your off hand. Pure style, since only the real knife lands hits, but no other effect changes your silhouette this much.

item.name: Electric Knife
item.obtainDetail: Buying for 1,000 Diamonds in the shop
item.cardSummary: Wraps the blade in a ring of purple electricity. One of the pricier Diamond effects and easy to spot from across a map.

item.name: Flaming Knife
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 4,000 Coins
item.cardSummary: The classic fire effect: your knife simply burns. Cheap for Coins and still one of the most recognizable looks in the game.

item.name: Ghostify
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 2,000 Coins or 200 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Turns the knife ghostly and translucent. One of the few effects sold for either Coins or Diamonds, so almost anyone can afford the spooky look.

item.name: Green Flaming Knife
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 800 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Burns the blade in green fire, the toxic-looking recolor of Flaming Knife at the same Diamond price as its blue and pink siblings.

item.name: Heartify
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 2,400 Coins
item.cardSummary: The knife sheds pink hearts, and anyone you take down ends up with a smiling heart-eyed face. The romance option, permanently in the shop.

item.name: Knifeception
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 300 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Your knife emits tiny copies of itself, a knife within a knife. The joke lands better the fancier the knife you pair it with.

item.name: Monify
item.cardSummary: Rained money particles off the blade before it quietly left the shop in 2016. One of the rarest shop effects simply because so few bought it in time.

item.name: Musical
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 2,000 Coins
item.cardSummary: Music notes float off the knife and stabs play a musical sting. One of the few effects you can hear as well as see.

item.name: Pink Flaming Knife
item.obtainDetail: Purchase in the Shop for 800 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Pink fire for the blade, the flashiest of the three colored flame recolors and the same Diamond price as the others.

item.name: Radioactive
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing from the Shop for 1,600 Coins
item.cardSummary: Coats the knife in green smoky particles and tints victims green, a budget Coins pick that still reads clearly in a dark map.

item.name: Bats
item.cardSummary: A swarm of little bats circles the blade constantly. A Halloween pack effect that pairs naturally with the season's knives.

item.name: Bitsplosion
item.cardSummary: Confetti-like colored bits spray from the knife, and victims burst into rainbow pixels. One of the few effects whose icon shows no knife at all.

item.name: Blizzard
item.cardSummary: Icicle particles spin around the blade. It came in the Winter Item Pack for 1299 Robux during the 2017 Christmas Event and left when the pack did.

item.name: Darkfire
item.cardSummary: Engulfs the knife in black flame and burns victims with it. The Shadow Item Pack's signature effect and a longtime favorite for dark loadouts.

item.name: Elite-ify
item.cardSummary: Dark elite skulls orbit the knife, and victims turn into black skeletons burning in red fire. One of the most aggressive death effects in the game.

item.name: Ethereal
item.cardSummary: Light blue smoke drifts off the blade. It shipped in the Ghostly Item Pack for 1,700 Robux during the 2019 Halloween Event.

item.name: Frostbite
item.cardSummary: An icy aura from the Frostbite Pack of the 2019 Christmas Event, gone since the pack was removed when the event closed.

item.name: Gearstorm
item.cardSummary: Gears spray from the knife and victims collapse into a pile of gears. The Clockwork Item Pack's effect, now offsale.

item.name: Ghostly
item.cardSummary: A teal and light green ghostly flare wraps the blade, spookier in motion than it sounds on paper.

item.name: Ice Magic
item.cardSummary: A blue and purple icy shimmer with light pink flecks flowing around the blade. One of the more delicate winter looks.

item.name: Petals
item.cardSummary: A pink haze of falling sakura petals surrounds the blade, the go-to pick for cherry-blossom loadouts.

item.name: Plasma
item.cardSummary: Purple and blue plasma arcs spark across the blade under a white glow. One of the most electric-looking effects available.

item.name: Rainbow
item.cardSummary: Radiant rainbow flames pour off the knife. The loudest of the flame effects and impossible to mistake for anything else.

item.name: Vampire
item.cardSummary: A red smoky haze with blood particles seeps from the blade. It came in the Vampire Item Pack for 1,699 Robux during a Halloween event and left when the pack went offsale.

item.name: Darkswirl
item.obtainDetail: Halloween Event 2023 - Buying the Darkness Bundle
item.cardSummary: A black aura coils around the blade and pours out of victims when they fall. The gloomiest of the pack effects.

item.name: Flow
item.obtainDetail: Summer Event 2023 - Buying the Ocean Bundle
item.cardSummary: A flowing blue aura with pool-reflection light lines, and victims give off blue flames when downed. A clean look for water-themed knives.

item.name: Aurora Lights
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2024 - Buying the Australis & Borealis Bundle
item.cardSummary: Blue and purple northern-light ribbons wrap the knife, and victims glow in the same aurora shades. A bundle effect built to match icy weapon skins.

item.name: Flowerwood
item.obtainDetail: Easter Event 2024 - Buying the Flowerwood Bundle Trading
item.cardSummary: Blue smoke and cyan particles tuned to the Flowerwood Bundle's palette. Made to complete that bundle's matching look.

item.name: Glisten
item.obtainDetail: Summer Event 2024 - Purchasing the Pearls Bundle
item.cardSummary: The blue and pink cousin of Sunbeams: the same beaming trail in cooler colors, with downed victims glowing in blue and pink sparkles.

item.name: Wraith
item.obtainDetail: Halloween Event 2024 - Buying the Spirit & Soul Bundle
item.cardSummary: White and black smoke shrouds the weapon and trails behind you as you move, and victims vanish into thick white smoke.

item.name: Bloom
item.obtainDetail: Easter Event 2025 - Buying the Bloom Bundle
item.cardSummary: A pastel pink aura with falling flowers and drifting petals that trail behind you as you move. One of the softest looks in the effect pool.

item.name: Snowstorm
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2025 - Buying the Snowstorm Bundle
item.cardSummary: A white and blue snowy aura with drifting flakes, and victims emit the same wintry swirl when downed.

item.name: Xeno
item.obtainDetail: Halloween Event 2025 - Buying the Xenotech Bundle
item.cardSummary: A purple electrical aura crackles around the knife, and downed victims emit purple lightning. The alien-tech look.

item.name: Ocean
item.obtainDetail: Summer Event 2026 - Buying the Beach Bundle
item.cardSummary: Neon blue and cyan aura with sparkles and tiny starfish drifting around the knife. Came with the Summer Event 2026 Beach Bundle.

item.name: Pixie Dust
item.obtainDetail: Valentines Event 2026 - Buying the Sweet Bundle
item.cardSummary: Pink and light yellow sparkles dust the knife, and victims shimmer with the same particles. Bought with the Valentines Event 2026 Sweet Bundle.

item.name: Poison
item.cardSummary: A dripping green haze seeps off the blade. A Halloween battle pass reward for players who like their knives toxic.

item.name: Frostfire
item.cardSummary: Cold-burning flames from tier 17 of the 2020 Christmas Event battle pass, an early example of the icy fire look.

item.name: Ghosts (2020)
item.cardSummary: White smog and faint mini ghosts drift off the blade. The 2020 Halloween battle pass entry that started the yearly ghost effect series.

item.name: Jingle
item.cardSummary: A red and green aura with sparkles rings the blade. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Snowfall
item.cardSummary: Small snowflakes fall gently around the blade. The subtle option among the winter battle pass effects.

item.name: Aurora
item.cardSummary: A pink and green aurora ripples around the knife. A Christmas battle pass reward for players who climbed the tiers.

item.name: Phantom
item.cardSummary: A smoky green ghoul haunts the knife. A Halloween battle pass reward with one of the most distinct silhouettes.

item.name: Snowflake
item.cardSummary: The knife shimmers white while snowflakes drift down. A Christmas battle pass reward, softer than the token-shop snowflake effects.

item.name: Starry
item.cardSummary: A yellow aura studded with stars wraps the knife. A battle pass reward that keeps things simple and bright.

item.name: Wraithfire
item.cardSummary: A smoky purple aura coils around the blade. A Halloween battle pass reward darker than most of its year.

item.name: Arctic
item.cardSummary: Dark and light blue mist swirls around the blade like arctic wind. Tier 18 of the Christmas Event 2022 battle pass.

item.name: Candies (2022)
item.cardSummary: Candies fade in and out around the blade in a steady loop. The 2022 Halloween battle pass take on the candy effect.

item.name: Chilly
item.cardSummary: Wispy white smoke curls off the blade like snow on the wind. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Minty
item.cardSummary: A red and white aura like a candy cane dissolved around the blade. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Pumpkin (2022)
item.cardSummary: A glowing orange aura with flickering jack-o-lantern faces. The 2022 Halloween battle pass pumpkin.

item.name: Stickers
item.cardSummary: Sticker versions of red and green baubles and peppermints ring the blade. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Toxic
item.cardSummary: A green aura with rising bubbles wraps the blade. A Halloween battle pass reward in classic hazard green.

item.name: Versus
item.cardSummary: Stickers of the Survivor and the Zombie King circle the knife, a souvenir of the event's two sides. A Halloween battle pass reward.

item.name: Candies (2023)
item.cardSummary: Differently colored candies orbit the knife on repeat. The 2023 Halloween battle pass version of the candy line.

item.name: Fireworks
item.cardSummary: Neon blue, red, green, and pink fireworks pop around the blade in varying shapes. A summer battle pass showstopper.

item.name: Ghosts (2023)
item.cardSummary: Small ghosts float out of the knife. The 2023 Halloween battle pass revision of the ghost line.

item.name: Glowy
item.cardSummary: Three glowing pumpkins in cyan, magenta, and yellow orbit the knife, cycling through nine colors. A Halloween battle pass standout.

item.name: Stars
item.cardSummary: A faint yellow aura with neon star outlines around the blade. Sits next to Starry in the night-sky family with a sharper look.

item.name: Swirls
item.cardSummary: Red-white and green-white peppermint swirls circle the knife. A Christmas battle pass reward that doubles as a candy shop ad.

item.name: Traveler's Flame
item.cardSummary: A flowing orange flame aura, and downed victims burn with orange flames from the head. A Halloween battle pass reward with an oddly specific death effect.

item.name: Celestial
item.cardSummary: A deep blue cloud with floating yellow dots and stars drifts around the knife. A battle pass reward for the space-minded.

item.name: Cursed
item.cardSummary: A fierce green flame-like aura built to match the Cursed Knife and Gun. A Halloween battle pass reward.

item.name: Flowers
item.cardSummary: A faint white aura with white daisies and petals. The quietest of the floral effects, from a spring battle pass.

item.name: Ghosts (2024)
item.cardSummary: Ghostly white smog with mini ghosts and no death effect. The 2024 entry in the yearly ghost series.

item.name: Gifts
item.cardSummary: Red and green presents tumble off the blade with no death effect. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Snowy
item.cardSummary: A white cloudy aura sheds snowflakes around the blade with no death effect. A Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Vampiric
item.cardSummary: A red smoky aura gives the blade a gloomy blood-tinged look with no death effect. A Halloween battle pass reward.

item.name: Abduction
item.cardSummary: A pale green UFO glow wraps the blade, and victims rise inside green abduction rings. Tier 24 of the Halloween Event 2025 battle pass.

item.name: Aquatic
item.cardSummary: A bright blue watery aura washes over the knife, with a matching splash on downed victims. A summer battle pass reward.

item.name: Cat Eyes
item.cardSummary: Black fog with glowing yellow cat eyes surrounds the blade, no death effect needed to be unsettling. A Halloween battle pass reward.

item.name: Confetti
item.cardSummary: Pink and white streamers burst from the knife with no death effect. The most celebratory thing you can stab someone with.

item.name: Flamingo
item.cardSummary: Flamingos and pink feathers circle the knife with no death effect. The summer battle pass at its least serious.

item.name: Frost
item.cardSummary: A gloomy cold sparkle wraps the blade, and a cold aura glows out of victims when they fall. An icy pick that stays readable in dark maps.

item.name: Heatwave
item.cardSummary: A bold orange fiery aura that also washes victims in vibrant orange. A summer battle pass reward that lives up to its name.

item.name: Retro
item.cardSummary: Funky neon shapes in green, red, yellow, and magenta bounce around the blade, and victims burst into the same shapes. A style statement from a summer battle pass.

item.name: Snowballs
item.cardSummary: Sticker-style snowballs pop around the knife with no death effect. A playful Christmas battle pass reward.

item.name: Synthwave
item.cardSummary: A neon aura of angular blue and purple shapes, with victims dissolving into a bluish-purple abstract glow. The retrowave pick of the battle pass effects.

item.name: Treats
item.cardSummary: Sticker-style candy wrappers, chocolate bars, gummy worms, and lollipops orbit the knife. A Halloween battle pass reward with no death effect.

item.name: UFOs
item.cardSummary: Little UFOs spawn and buzz around the blade with no death effect. A Halloween battle pass reward.

item.name: Bat Swarm
item.cardSummary: Bats pour out of the blade in a steady stream. Earned in the Vampire Hunt minigame by eliminating 25 Villagers.

item.name: Candy Cane
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing it for 20 Snowflake Tokens during the 2017 Christmas Event (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Trails candy cane particles behind the blade. Bought with 20 Snowflake Tokens in the 2017 Christmas Event.

item.name: Gingerbread
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing it for 100 Snowflake Tokens during the 2017 Christmas Event (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Trails gingerbread men behind the knife. Cost 100 Snowflake Tokens in the 2017 Christmas Event, five times the price of Candy Cane.

item.name: Knife Wrapper
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing for 60 Snowflake Tokens during the 2017 Christmas Event (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Wraps the entire knife in green Christmas paper. The one effect that hides your skin instead of decorating it, which is its own kind of flex.

item.name: Northern Lights
item.obtainDetail: Purchasing it for 2,000 Snowflake Tokens during the 2018 Christmas Event (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Blue, pink, and green aurora ribbons wrap the knife. An event reward that reads beautifully on dark maps.

item.name: Snowflakes
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2016 - Buying for 85 Blue Tokens (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Snowflake particles drift off the blade. Bought with 85 Blue Tokens at Santa's Workshop in the 2016 Christmas Event, making it one of the oldest event effects.

item.name: Pumpkin (2017)
item.cardSummary: Small pumpkins sprout on the blade. Sold for just 50 Coins in the Halloween Event 2017, one of the cheapest event effects ever.

item.name: Snowflakes 2017
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2017 - Buying for 10 Snowflake Tokens (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Trails of snowflake particles follow the knife. The 2017 rerun of the snowflake idea, distinct from the 2016 original.

item.name: Common Ornament
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2018 - Purchasing for one Common Ornament (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: The knife sheds white ornaments, the entry tier of the ornament trio handed out at Christmas.

item.name: Legendary Ornament
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2018 - Purchasing for one Legendary Ornament (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: The knife sheds red ornaments, the top tier of the Christmas ornament trio.

item.name: Rare Ornament
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2018 - Purchasing for one Rare Ornament (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: The knife sheds green ornaments, the middle tier of the Christmas ornament trio.

item.name: Uncommon Ornament
item.obtainDetail: Christmas Event 2018 - Purchasing for one Uncommon Ornament (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: The knife sheds blue ornaments, the second step of the Christmas ornament trio.

item.name: Candies (2019)
item.cardSummary: Candy particles spill from the knife. An early Halloween battle pass treat from 2019 that started the candy-effect tradition.

item.name: Batswarm
item.cardSummary: A swarm of bats circles the knife. An event reward that predates the similar Vampire Hunt effect, so the two often get mixed up.

item.name: Hallow's Blaze
item.cardSummary: An orange misty haze smolders off the blade, tuned to jack-o-lantern orange for its Halloween event.

item.name: Easter Glow
item.cardSummary: A soft glow earned by collecting 4,000 Eggs in the 2023 Easter Event, the grind reward of that spring.

item.name: Floral
item.cardSummary: Neon pink and cyan hibiscus flowers bloom around the blade. A summer event reward with the brightest floral palette in the pool.

item.name: Jellyfish
item.cardSummary: Jellyfish in purple, green, yellow, red, and blue drift lazily around the knife. A summer event reward and one of the most animated effects.

item.name: Matrix
item.cardSummary: A green spiky aura with lime rectangles raining like code. The closest MM2 gets to hacker aesthetics.

item.name: Sunbeams
item.cardSummary: An intense golden light beams off the knife like caught sunlight. The warm original that Glisten later recolored.

item.name: Carrots
item.cardSummary: Little cartoon carrots hop off the weapon with no death effect. An Easter event reward that commits fully to the theme.

item.name: Christmas Glow
item.cardSummary: A red and green aura with matching particles, basically mistletoe for your knife. A Christmas event reward.

item.name: Leaves
item.obtainDetail: Thanksgiving Event 2025 - Purchasing for 4,000 Coins, or 400 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: Yellow-orange maple leaves drift off the blade. Sold for 4,000 Coins or 400 Diamonds during the 2025 Thanksgiving event.

item.name: Rainbows (2025)
item.cardSummary: Small rainbows arc around the blade with no death effect. Earned by collecting 10 Rare Eggs for the final Rare Egg reward tier in the Easter Event 2025.

item.name: Bubbly
item.cardSummary: Bubbles of all sizes fizz around the blade. Unboxed from 6 Summer Boxes during the Summer Event 2026.

item.name: Hearts
item.cardSummary: A pink aura full of floating hearts. Earned by completing 12 event quests in the Valentines Event 2026.

item.name: Nightlife
item.cardSummary: Blue-to-magenta night-sky shades with stars and sparks around the blade. Unboxed from 20 Summer Boxes in the Summer Event 2026.

item.name: Strawberries
item.cardSummary: Strawberry particles bounce off the blade with no death effect. Earned from 3 event quests in the Valentines Event 2026.

item.name: Bokeh
item.cardSummary: Surrounds the blade with soft yellow translucent circles, like out-of-focus lights in a photo. Crafted in the Christmas Event 2025 crafting tab.

item.name: Coal
item.cardSummary: Chunks of coal tumble around the knife with no death effect. The naughty-list craft from the Christmas Event 2025 crafting tab.

item.name: Lights
item.cardSummary: Strings multicolored Christmas lights around the blade. A cheerful Christmas Event 2025 craft with no death effect.

item.name: Nightsky
item.cardSummary: A dark purple aura speckled with stars turns the knife into a slice of night. The prettiest of the Christmas Event 2025 crafts.

item.name: Rainbow Fire
item.obtainDetail: Purchase anything from MM2's official shop during the promotion. (Formerly)Purchase it for 5000 Coins for a limited time (Formerly)
item.cardSummary: Burns the knife in shifting rainbow flames. It came from buying real-world MM2 merchandise, so supply stopped when the promotion did.

item.name: Void
item.obtainDetail: Collecting the rewards in Murder Mystery 2 after redeeming Roblox’s Murder Mystery Crown hat through Amazon Prime Gaming (Expired)
item.cardSummary: A dark purple void aura earned by redeeming the Murder Mystery Crown from Amazon Prime Gaming. The promo expired, making this one of the scarcer effects.
